title: QA Automation Engineer (DevOps) - Unified Communications & Contact Center Platforms
jobDescription:
organization, offering comprehensive benefits and opportunities.Learn more at betsol.com Job Description: About the Platform This role supports Contact Center as a Service (CCaa S) — a cloud-native, AI-driven customer experience platform delivering omnichannel customer engagement, intelligent routing, conversational AI, workforce optimization, analytics, and agent desktop capabilities. The platform follows an Agile/Scrum delivery model, with fast-paced delivery, frequent releases, and CI/CD deployment pipelines. About the Role We are seeking highly skilled Platform/Dev Ops Senior QA engineers to drive quality engineering for Unified Communications (UC) and Contact Center platforms. This role focuses on validating delivery and runtime behavior for Dev Ops-led changes across CI/CD, deployments, shared environments, platform integrations, and service reliability. Engineers will own automation strategy, release quality evidence, deployment validation, and runtime assurance in partnership with Platform, Dev Ops, Cloud, and Product Engineering teams. The ideal candidate brings strong automation engineering expertise, critical system-thinking, and hands-on experience validating cloud-native deployments, APIs, platform integrations, and operational readiness in large-scale enterprise communication ecosystems. Responsibilities* Design, develop, and maintain automated validation frameworks for Dev Ops delivery flows, including build validation, artifact verification, deployment validation, smoke/health testing, rollback testing, and release readiness. * Validate Kubernetes-backed deployments for Unified Communications and Contact Center workloads, including rollout status, readiness/liveness behavior, ingress, service exposure, pod health, and runtime observability. * Integrate automated validation suites into CI/CD pipelines such as Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, and Azure Dev Ops to enable continuous quality gates. * Validate end-to-end service integrations across communication workflows, APIs, platform services, identity systems, and dependent microservices. * Analyze and triage failures across pipeline logs, deployment metadata, Kubernetes events, and runtime logs to identify defects affecting delivery stability and cross-team integration. * Own automation coverage strategy, quality gates, test cataloging, and exit criteria for Dev Ops-led platform changes. * Reduce test instability by identifying flaky automation patterns and improving reliability, diagnostics, and repeatability. * Validate REST APIs, JSON/YAML payloads, service contracts, and integration points for UC and Contact Center capabilities. * Document environment dependencies, limitations, validation evidence, release readiness metrics, and defect impact assessments. * Collaborate with Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, SRE, Cloud, and Product teams to improve delivery quality, deployment confidence, and operational resilience.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Required Qualifications* 6–8 years of experience in QA Automation, SDET, Software Test Engineering, or Platform Validation roles. * Strong programming expertise in Python, Type Script, Java, or C# with solid Git/Git workflow experience. * Hands-on experience integrating automation into CI/CD systems such as Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure Dev Ops. * Strong Kubernetes validation experience, including kubectl usage, rollout verification, pod inspection, log analysis, service troubleshooting, readiness/liveness validation, and deployment debugging. * Hands-on experience validating containers, REST APIs, JSON/YAML payloads, and distributed platform integrations. * Cloud validation experience with Azure and GCP, including environment validation and deployment verification. * Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyze failures across logs, deployment metadata, and integration paths. * Experience defining automation coverage, release exit criteria, and quality evidence for production readiness. Collaboration* Pair with engineers on design reviews, feature-freeze planning, and Day-2 playbooks as a peer — catching quality issues before code is written, not after. B. Soft Skills* Collaborates as a peer, not a downstream verifier — comfortable in design reviews and planning, not just execution. * Clear, accountable communicator able to write test documentation for mixed technical and non-technical audiences. * Strong problem-solving instincts and comfort operating across two platforms in parallel. * Security mindset and outcome focus, measuring success by platform reliability and defect prevention. Good to Have* Zephyr or native Jira Test issuetype experience. * Litmus Chaos, Chaos Mesh, or equivalent chaos-engineering experience. * Prior Fed RAMP work, or experience in similar regulated environments (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, DISA STIG). * Experience with distributed data services: Kafka, Redis, Maria DB/Galera, Min IO or other S3-compatible object storage.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
